svg.text: forty particles dropped; 526 grains nobody placed
Left, a pattern laid on a grid. Right, a box, some gravity, and a grain each time something lands on the floor: the rules
were chosen, the notes were not.
The grains crowd together and fade as the particles come to rest. Height is pitch; a red dot's size is how hard it landed. A
landing slower than a set speed makes no grain, and that cut-off sets the count.
